title: 2003 HMMT February Geometry Problem 3
statement: A room is built in the shape of the region between two semicircles with the same center and parallel diameters. The farthest distance between two points with a clear line of sight is 12 m . What is the area (in \(\mathrm{m}^{2}\) ) of the room?

solutions.text:
\(18 \pi\)
The maximal distance is as shown in the figure. Call the radii \(R\) and \(r, R>r\). Then \(R^{2}-r^{2}=6^{2}\) by the Pythagorean theorem, so the area is \((\pi / 2) \cdot\left(R^{2}-r^{2}\right)=18 \pi\).
